dedupe_keys.name: estimation of building height in halle using digital elevation data

description: FAIRiCUBE deposits a building-height raster for Halle, Germany, estimated from the difference between a digital surface model and a digital terrain model. The provider says the mean surface-minus-terrain value within each building footprint became that building’s height. Zenodo lists a public GeoTIFF of about 9.8 MB with CC BY 4.0 rights metadata. These estimates could set roof elevations in a city energy, flood-exposure or urban-climate simulation. This method differs from two other Halle releases based on OpenStreetMap levels and a Geoclimate random forest; the products are alternatives, not repeated measured observations. The public description does not identify the elevation products’ dates, vertical datum or error distribution. Roof structures, trees and DEM alignment may affect the inferred heights. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this named raster. The GeoTIFF was not downloaded, so pixel values, projection and coverage edges were not checked.
